findings.title: SystemExit and early outer setup escape registered finally ownership
findings.definite_shutdown_risk: residual non-daemon child unbounded join and restored waitpid after held references close
findings.early_error_example: EIO at first OWNED_LEADER event before outer resource try/finally
findings.required_boundary: unconditional final real_os._exit including flush/error-report exceptions; own resources immediately after creation

findings.title: Pidfd signals lack a common absolute deadline at actual dispatch
findings.counterexample: finally entered at elapsed51.01 still dispatches SIGKILL; logging may also return after deadline before syscall
findings.required_boundary: one shared absolute51 deadline checked after logging/IPC immediately before each signal; expired means UNKNOWN and no dispatch

findings.title: Late final fsync can retain PASS and exit0 beyond51 seconds
findings.counterexample: elapsed50.99 passes check; fsync returns at52; END still contains PASS/exit0 even if elapsed field exceeds51
findings.required_boundary: late or partial finalization must block final PASS; independent actual outer monotonic end/exit/reap evidence remains mandatory

findings.title: Original identity/kernel observers still traverse bare PID proc paths
findings.counterexample: A is verified, exits and is reaped; reused integer is read by bare identity/fd walk before later birth mismatch rejects it
findings.required_boundary: case-only observer/identity adapters using retained kernel references or rejecting terminal/unknown ownership before lookup; original runtime/financial source unchanged
